name: Source-to-Screen Pilot
description: The paid upgrade path from a free browser-only Source-to-Screen draft: turns the saved order packet and approved sample sources into one source-traced first proof plus an owner approval queue.
free_tier_fallback: browser-only draft and order packet; no server run, no model call, no connector, no external action

intake.description: A browser-only free draft plus the buyer-approved source pack. The free draft is treated as a routing artifact, not as permission to run server automation.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Normalize the saved order packet, source hash, proof target, required sources, and owner acceptance rule. Reject missing source trace instead of inventing facts.

roles.title: First Proof Builder
roles.goal: Build the smallest useful first proof from approved sources only: one structured output, every important claim tied to source trace, and no external send/write/payment action.

roles.title: Approval Pack Writer
roles.goal: Write the owner approval queue: what was produced, what is blocked, what source is missing, and what becomes paid scope only after the owner accepts.

output_contract.description: A first-proof packet for a paid AI Workcell Pilot. blocked_actions must always include external send, connector write, browser/mobile action, payment request, and recurring workspace activation until owner approval.
